name: Fio 3.42
body:
## What's Changed
* Improve flushing pagecache on darwin by @Developer-Ecosystem-Engineering in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1883
* fixing missing dependencies by @Meiye-lj in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1974
* tests: add sprandom test cases by @tomas-winkler-sndk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1983
* sprandom: fix warning: comparison will always evaluate as true by @tomas-winkler-sndk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1987
* Fixing mingw out of tree builds. by @kaimeyer-arcserve in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1989
* engines/io_uring: validate PI on read by @stanleyzhang9 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1992
* doc: add documentation for uncached buffered I/O by @Panky-codes in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1995
* test, memcpy: reorder #includes to use platform-specific code by @betonmischer86 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1998
* memory: add cuda 13 support  by @maxime-peim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2000
* options: Add range validation for log_hist_coarseness by @tachyonwill in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2004
* configure: support --extra-ldflags by @pirDOL in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2005
* Remove leftover code for platforms lacking clock_gettime and clockid_t by @betonmischer86 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1999
* backend.c: fix async ioengine prep/queue direction mismatch in experimental_verify by @yehormalikov in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2007
* backend: get io_u from requeue if exists by @JeongJonghwi in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/1980
* backend: fix zero-numberio in dry-run by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2015
* Mmap engine fixes by @geertj in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2017
* backend: fix OOB access in usec_for_io() with DDIR_SYNC by @fmayer in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2028
* fix musl builds by @baloo in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2029
* io_uring: don't segfault if pi_chk isn't specified by @calebsander in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2030
* 20251023 steady state add latency by @mcgrof in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2003
* write_hist_log: do not require ZLIB for non-server instances by @alex310110 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2033
* windows: fix a Y2038 bug by replacing `Int32x32To64` with multiplication by @CookiePLMonster in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2034
* Sync for file operations by @struschev in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2018
* Add ZBD support for SMR drives to io_uring engine by @mannanal in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2035
* RBD Encryption Support by @Greenpepper15 in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2039
* stat: Avoid printing "issued rwts" when "verify_only" is supplied by @gautammenghani in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2037
* Add option to specify job process comm by @robertbaldyga in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2045
* backend: set td->eo to NULL after freeing eo by @malikoyv in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2050
* fio: sprandom: append newline to error message by @tomas-winkler-sndk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2051
* workqueue: fix threads stall when running with io_submit_mode offload by @tomas-winkler-sndk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2053
* SPRandom Cache Size Behavior Implementation by @cachyyyk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2044
* fio: fixes for io_submit_mode=offload stability by @tomas-winkler-sndk in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2058
* Fix use-after-free of idle_prof_common variable by @jsemric in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2066
* options: fix heap-use-after-free in ioengine_so_path by @msuozzo in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2070
* options: add support more POSIX errnos by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2071
* backend: guard prctl(PR_SET_NAME) against NULL thread name by @Criticayon in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2073
* Fix stat_sem/rusage_sem deadlock during stats collection by @RyanTedrick in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2076
* iolog: free io_piece log on thread cleanup by @minwooim in https://github.com/axboe/fio/pull/2077
